script.title: Piplup — A Little Wave
script.description: A freestanding, large-scale Piplup greeting its trainer: rounded sky-blue head, twin white cheek patches, sparkling oval eyes, smiling yellow bill, navy scalloped collar, two white belly buttons and three-toed feet. A raised flipper gives the silhouette an eager, playful gesture.
